rv.q: The show feels new and more overwhelming on Broadway, the consequence of a staging so fully imagined, sensitively expanded and brilliantly executed.
Maybe Happy Ending is buoyed not only by the endearing performances but by a score that effectively makes a case that the genre known as Theater still has plenty of joy and pleasures to offer.
It's a darling gem of a show with a big heart and a captivating sideways sensibility.
Maybe Happy Ending is an undeniably moving, well-made, adorable musical, and it is a pleasant surprise to see an audience weep at a show about two robots in love.
This is a very special show; a tender, visionary ode to the space we're able to create and hold for feeling, and the hope that it may continue.
No maybe about it — Maybe Happy Ending has theatrical magic.
Maybe Happy Ending exudes an undeniable charm and warmth, which sets it apart from many other new Broadway musicals these days that go for bombast over emotion.
